chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Umar from Ibn Udhayfir from Ibn Yazid from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"When the sun declines on the Day of Arafah, cease the Talbiyah, perform Ghusl, and engage in Takbir, Tahlil, Tahmid, Tasbih, and praising Allah, and pray Dhuhr and Asr with one Adhan and two Iqamas."

key_terms.إِقَامَة: Iqama (second call to prayer, immediately preceding the prayer)
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: Talbiyah (the declaration of 'Here I am, O Allah' recited during Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific rituals and prayer rulings for the Day of Arafah according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) details the precise ritual protocol for the Day of Arafah, emphasizing the transition from the state of Ihram to the preparation for the Prophet's Farewell Sermon by ceasing the Talbiyah at solar decline. It prescribes a specific method of Jam' al-Qasr (combining and shortening prayers) using one Adhan and two Iqamas, reflecting the scholarly consensus on the flexibility of prayer timing during Hajj. This guidance underscores the spiritual significance of Arafah as a day of purification and divine mercy, linking physical rituals with continuous remembrance (dhikr).
